title: Introduction and overview — Type 212 Submarine
description: Signature-original re-engineering study: introduction and overview of the Type 212 Submarine. This is a Signature-original design study, explicitly labeled and never presented as public record. Baseline reference: German-Italian AIP submarine; 10 built; fuel-cell propulsion; weeks submerged.. The German-Italian Type 212 — ten built — was the first submarine class with hydrogen fuel-cell air-independent propulsion, allowing weeks submerged without snorkeling. At 1,830 tons, the 212A set new standards for conventional-submarine stealth; the larger Type 212CD is on order for Germany and Norway.
